verses.english: “The appearance of one individual, mendicants, is rare in the world.
The Realized One, the perfected one, the fully awakened Buddha.

verses.pali: Imassa kho, bhikkhave, ekapuggalassa pātubhāvo dullabho lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: This is the one individual, mendicants, whose appearance is rare in the world.”
